privileged_info_for_vlm: The new survey must be titled 'Youth Development Study - Wave 2'. It must NOT contain the group 'Baseline Demographics'. It MUST contain 'School Experience' and 'Family Context'. It MUST contain a new group 'Recent Changes' with a Yes/No question (code: 'moved', text: 'Have you moved to a different home in the past 12 months?'). The survey must be in an 'Active' state at the end of the trajectory.
